question: After the source-drift defect is fixed, should production repair automerge adopt the Administration-scoped verifier and receipt-bound four-stage publication flow?
rationale: The repair is mechanical, but granting a new App permission and changing the trusted production mutation boundary require explicit maintainer authorization.

options.title: Fix and stage rollout
options.body: Repair the guard, land with mutation gates disabled, prove blocked and successful paths, and then enable the verifier.

options.title: Keep automerge disabled
options.body: Use the staged-proof infrastructure while deferring Administration access and merge-capable publication.

options.title: Split privileged finalization
options.body: Separate ruleset verification and token-only publication into a narrower follow-up for independent approval.

recommendation.title: Fix and stage rollout
recommendation.body: Repair the guard, land with mutation gates disabled, prove blocked and successful paths, and then enable the verifier.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main and PR history identify Vincent Koc as the feature owner best positioned to coordinate the repair and rollout.
